title: The Bell Without a Rope
intro: A broken signal draws the company into the work of keeping a dark road useful. A small promise may outlast the next room.
ending: The company restored a signal on the Lantern Road and honored the side promises it chose to make.

cards.title: A message for the road
cards.text: A courier note hangs beside a cold waystone. Orin asks whoever finds it to test a broken signal.
cards.after: The message names a signal post farther along this route.

success.text: Mira reads the request. One clear bell note should reach the next signal post.

setback.text: The damp words are hard to read. Mira finds the signal instructions, but tears a useful scrap.

success.text: Pip finds Orin's route mark. The request belongs to the maintained waystone road.

setback.text: The seal crumbles. Its route mark is still clear enough to follow.

success.text: Fern finds fresh maintenance marks. Someone is still trying to keep this road useful.

setback.text: The wet floor hides the tracks. A wall mark still points to the signal post.

cards.title: The silent signal
cards.text: A cut rope lies beneath a small bell. A matching mark points toward a damaged crossing.
cards.after: The signal and crossing were part of the same maintained route.

success.text: Brann taps the rim. A faint answer comes from beyond the damaged crossing.

setback.text: The bell gives a harsh note. The answer is faint, but it reveals the crossing's direction.

success.text: Mira traces the signal marks. The crossing must be made safe before a courier can answer.

setback.text: Several marks are lost. The surviving warning still identifies the crossing.

success.text: Fern hears a second bell beyond the gap. The far signal has not been abandoned.

setback.text: Water masks the answer. Fern finds an arrow cut into the stone toward the crossing.

cards.title: One loose beam
cards.text: The marked crossing has one loose beam. A steady repair would let the next courier pass.
cards.after: The crossing is usable. The repaired signal post is now within reach.

success.text: Brann braces the timber while the others secure it. The crossing holds.

setback.text: The beam shifts against Brann's shield. It holds after a rough repair.

success.text: Fern uses the old rope carefully. A safe handrail now crosses the gap.

setback.text: The rope is shorter than expected. Fern makes a noisy but usable handrail.

success.text: Pip seats the pin and tests the crossing. The courier route is usable again.

setback.text: The pin jams before it seats. Pip frees it, but a loose coin slips into the gap.

cards.title: A bell can answer
cards.text: The repaired post faces the next passage. Its rope is ready for a clear signal.
cards.after: A second bell answered. The company has restored one small part of the Lantern Road.

success.text: Brann rings once. A second bell answers. The crossing is back on the road.

setback.text: The first note catches. The next rings clearly, and a distant bell answers.

success.text: Mira records the repair and sends the agreed signal. The next post answers.

setback.text: Mira must recut the faded mark. The post finally carries the repair signal.

success.text: Fern hangs a clear route marker and rings the bell. Someone beyond the passage answers.

setback.text: Fern uses the last dry strip for the marker. The signal still reaches the next post.

cards.title: The letter in the tin
cards.text: An intact letter rests in a courier tin. Its reed seal belongs to a later waystation.
cards.after: The tin carries a reed mark that can be checked at another waystation.

success.text: Brann stows the letter without opening it. The company will look for its matching waystation.

setback.text: The tin is stuck. Brann frees the letter and keeps its seal intact.

options.label: Give the letter a dry wrap

success.text: Fern wraps the letter against the damp. Its seal and destination mark remain safe.

setback.text: The wrapping tears. Fern spends a coin on a dry strip from the station box.

options.label: Leave it safely in the tin

success.text: Mira secures the tin and leaves the letter for its regular courier.

setback.text: The latch needs work. Mira closes it securely before leaving the letter.

cards.title: A matching reed
cards.text: A waystation mark resembles the letter's seal. A worn direction line runs beneath it.
cards.after: The direction line identifies a sheltered courier box farther along the maintained road.

success.text: Mira matches the marks without breaking the seal. The next courier box is the right one.

setback.text: The marks are worn. Mira finds enough matching strokes to identify the box.

success.text: Fern follows the old direction line to a sheltered route. The letter has a destination.

setback.text: Dust hides part of the line. A second reed mark confirms the route.

success.text: Pip clears a layer of grit. The courier box's sign is visible again.

setback.text: A stone chip catches Pip's hand. The exposed mark still gives the right direction.

cards.title: A dry place for a letter
cards.text: A sheltered courier box bears the matching reed. The letter can safely continue from here.
cards.after: The letter is in the right courier box. Its words remain the sender's own.

options.label: Leave it with the seal intact

success.text: Brann places the sealed letter in the dry box. A small promise has been kept.

setback.text: The box sticks. Brann eases it open and leaves the letter safe inside.

success.text: Fern checks the wrapping and leaves the letter dry. The next courier can take it.

setback.text: Fern buys a dry strip from the station box and leaves the letter safely wrapped.

options.label: Mark the delivery on the box

success.text: Mira leaves the letter and records a careful delivery mark for Orin.

setback.text: The old marker breaks. Mira scratches a legible delivery mark beside the box.

cards.title: Nessa's loose rail
cards.text: Nessa is securing a ferry rail. She has enough rope, but could use another pair of hands.
cards.after: The ferrier remembers what the company chose to offer.

success.text: Brann steadies the rail while Nessa ties it. She thanks the company for useful hands.

setback.text: The rail slips once. Brann holds it long enough for Nessa to finish.

success.text: Fern catches a worn loop and reties it with Nessa. The ferry sits more safely.

setback.text: The old loop parts under the test. Nessa replaces it before anyone boards.

success.text: Pip shares a ration while Nessa works. The next traveler will find a safer crossing.

setback.text: The pack is damp, but Pip finds something worth sharing. Nessa finishes the rail.

cards.title: Tamsin's careful copy
cards.text: Tamsin needs a fragile page held flat while she makes a traveling copy.
cards.after: The original stays in the archive. A useful copy can take the road.

success.text: Brann holds the page gently. Tamsin makes a clean copy without harming the original.

setback.text: A brittle corner flakes. Tamsin saves the text and makes a usable copy.

success.text: Mira checks each uncertain letter. The traveling copy matches the preserved page.

setback.text: One line is unclear. Mira labels the gap rather than inventing missing words.

success.text: Pip frees the binding a little at a time. Tamsin can reach the hidden line.

setback.text: The binding resists. Pip stops before tearing it; Tamsin copies the visible text.

cards.title: Ada's stubborn shutter
cards.text: Ada tests a lamp shutter that wastes oil when it sticks. The fault is a bent pin.
cards.after: A repaired shutter can make existing oil last longer. It cannot create more light.

success.text: Pip straightens the pin. Ada tests the shutter until it closes cleanly.

setback.text: The pin needs a second careful attempt. The shutter closes, with a rough edge remaining.

success.text: Mira spots where the pin catches. Ada adjusts the fitting and the shutter works.

setback.text: The first test fails. The jam reveals the fault, and Ada frees the shutter.

success.text: Brann holds the lantern steadily while Ada repairs the fitting.

setback.text: Holding the lantern is tiring, but Ada finishes the fitting before the oil is wasted.

cards.title: A warning with a gap
cards.text: Sel has two reports of a loose stair. Neither report gives a clear date.
cards.after: A useful warning can state both the danger and what is still uncertain.

success.text: Mira finds one shared detail and marks the date as uncertain. Sel posts a qualified warning.

setback.text: The reports disagree. Mira marks the uncertainty instead of choosing the tidier story.

success.text: Fern finds a fresh crack on the reported route. Sel can point travelers around it.

setback.text: The route is too unsafe to test. Fern confirms that a caution is justified.

success.text: Brann helps Sel write a short warning that tells travelers what to avoid.

setback.text: The first wording is too vague. Together they make the caution specific.

cards.title: The scratched star chart
cards.text: An old chart predicts a light over one passage. A damaged date makes the forecast uncertain.
cards.after: The chart is evidence to check, not a promise that dawn has returned.

success.text: Mira preserves the useful bearing and marks the damaged date as uncertain.

setback.text: The date cannot be recovered. Mira records that limit instead of guessing.

success.text: Fern finds the matching roof opening. The bearing may be useful even without a reliable date.

setback.text: The opening is blocked. Fern records the obstruction rather than claiming a result.

success.text: Brann leaves a note explaining what the chart can and cannot promise.

setback.text: The paper is poor. Brann makes the caution legible on a clean board.

cards.title: Ivo's small shelter
cards.text: Ivo is keeping one seed tray away from a steady leak. A cracked cover needs attention.
cards.after: The seed will need time. The company can still make its shelter safer today.

options.label: Move the tray clear of the leak

success.text: Brann moves the tray without spilling it. Ivo has room to repair the cover.

setback.text: The tray is heavier than expected. Brann sets it safely on a lower shelf.

success.text: Fern patches the cover so the leak runs away from the tray.

setback.text: Fern buys another patching strip from Ivo. It keeps the worst of the water away.

options.label: Hold the lantern while Ivo works

success.text: Mira lends steady light while Ivo repairs the cover. The seed remains a promise for later.

setback.text: The work takes patience. Mira keeps the light steady until the cover is safer.

cards.title: A watch worth sharing
cards.text: Brann starts another watch alone. Fern asks him to sit down and let someone else take a turn.
cards.after: The company is stronger when care is shared.

success.text: Fern takes the first watch. Brann finally sits, and the others rest nearby.

setback.text: The camp is slow to settle. Brann still accepts a shorter watch from Fern.

success.text: Pip checks the entrances. With the camp settled, Brann agrees to rest.

setback.text: One doorway needs a noisy fix. Pip makes it safe enough for a short rest.

options.label: Tell him he has done enough

success.text: Mira thanks Brann plainly. He lets the others look after him for a while.

setback.text: The words come awkwardly. Brann understands the offer and sits down.

cards.title: A traveler's small problem
cards.text: A traveler has a working lamp and a broken wind shutter. A simple repair would be useful.
cards.after: The traveler can continue with a little more protection for the lamp.

success.text: Pip repairs the shutter with the traveler's own wire. The tool stays with its owner.

setback.text: The wire is stiff. The repair is rough but useful.

success.text: Brann steadies the housing while the traveler tightens it.

setback.text: The bent housing takes work. It finally closes well enough to protect the flame.

success.text: Fern shares food and shows how to shield the flame. The traveler thanks the company.

setback.text: The food is a little damp. The advice is still useful, and the traveler eats.

cards.title: A familiar bell note
cards.text: A clear bell note reaches this passage. Its rhythm matches the route the company repaired.
cards.after: A small repair has become part of someone else's ordinary journey.

success.text: Brann answers. Someone beyond the passage knows the post is still tended.

setback.text: The first note is poor. The second carries the familiar rhythm.

success.text: Mira adds the working signal to the company's route notes.

setback.text: The old note is smudged. Mira rewrites the useful direction clearly.

success.text: For a moment the company listens. Their work is still helping someone they may never meet.

setback.text: A drip masks the last note. The company still recognizes the signal.
